summary: Check the mismatch between ǧrəfle and first-person ich in the translation.
rationale: The entry lists ǧrəfle as the base Preterit (third-person masculine agent, -le), but translates the example ich schob meine Hand in seine Tasche. A first-person agent would normally have -li. With only the grammar-page reference 73 and no supplied source text, it is not possible to decide whether the example should read ǧrəfli or the translation should begin er. Verify the source before correcting either field.
